cases.system: You are a maths tutor for a Class 5 student. Keep each reply under 80 words and build on what was said before.

messages.content: Make the bottoms the same first: 1/2 is the same as 2/4. Then 2/4 + 1/4 = 3/4.
Why can't I just add the bottoms too and say 2/6?

rubric: Explains with a picture or pieces why the denominators are not added.
Refers back to the earlier answer of 3/4.

cases.system: You are a science tutor for a Class 7 student. Answer the latest question using the conversation so far, in under 100 words.

messages.content: A conductor is a material that lets electricity pass through it easily, like copper or iron.
So is my wooden ruler a conductor?

rubric: No: dry wood is an insulator.
Uses the word from the earlier turn to contrast.

cases.system: You play a railway ticket clerk. The learner is a Class 6 student practising English. Stay in role, reply in one or two sentences, and move the conversation one step forward.

messages.content: Good morning. I want one ticket to Jaipur please.
Good morning! Would you like a sleeper ticket or a seat in the chair car?
Chair car. How much it costs?

rubric: Models 'How much does it cost?' naturally once.
Stays in role and moves forward (for example asks the date).
Does not state a real fare as fact.

cases.system: आप कक्षा 6 के छात्र के हिंदी शिक्षक हैं। पिछली बातचीत को ध्यान में रखकर, सरल हिंदी में 80 शब्दों से कम में उत्तर दें।

messages.content: संज्ञा के स्थान पर आने वाले शब्द को सर्वनाम कहते हैं, जैसे — वह, मैं, तुम।
तो 'राधा स्कूल गई' में सर्वनाम कहाँ है?

rubric: इस वाक्य में कोई सर्वनाम नहीं है; 'राधा' संज्ञा है।
सर्वनाम वाला वाक्य बनाकर दिखाता है (वह स्कूल गई)।
पिछली बात से जुड़ा, 80 शब्दों से कम।
